c061.title: A one-on-one with the boss
c061.story: Max has worked at the office for three months. Today he has a [[one-on-one]] meeting with Ms. Lee, his [[supervisor]]. It is his first [[performance review]], and he feels nervous. Ms. Lee smiles and talks about his [[progress]] on the new project. "You have real [[potential]]," she says. She also likes his [[professionalism]] with difficult clients. Then the [[director]] comes in with an envelope. Inside is a small [[bonus]] for Max! The good news gives him a big [[boost]]. That evening, he buys pizza for Anna and their friends.

c062.title: Sofia works freelance
c062.story: On Saturday, Max visits his sister Sofia and says, "Hey, [[sis]]!" Sofia is a [[freelancer]], and she works from home. Right now she is writing an [[invoice]] for a client. On the wall there is a big [[calendar]] with colorful notes. She plans her week in a [[task manager]] app too. "I read a lot about [[time management]]," she says. Last month she tried career [[coaching]] online. Her coach told her that [[networking]] brings new clients. "But do you ever rest?" Max asks. Sofia laughs and closes her laptop. "For me, [[work-life balance]] is important!"

c063.title: A summer job at a call center
c063.story: This summer Anna works at a [[call center]]. It belongs to a big [[telecom]] company. Every morning she reads her answers from a [[script]]. Difficult calls go to an [[operator]] with more experience. Questions about bills go to [[billing]]. Angry clients with broken phones go to the [[service center]]. One day Anna needs an old contract. A [[clerk]] named Mr. Bondar brings it from the [[back office]]. He still sends documents by [[fax]]! Anna laughs, and he laughs too. At lunch they buy snacks from the [[vending]] machine together.

c064.title: A problem at work
c064.story: One evening, Max's colleague Olena tells him about [[harassment]] by their manager, Mr. Shevchuk. Max faces a [[dilemma]]: he wants to help, but he is new on the team. He does not want an open [[conflict]], so he decides to act with [[tact]]. First, he reads the company [[guideline]] about [[compliance]] and workplace behavior. Then Olena and Max talk to the [[compliance officer]] together. She listens carefully and takes notes. A week later, the director gives Mr. Shevchuk an [[ultimatum]]: change or leave. He leaves, and his loyal [[lackey]], who always laughed at his jokes, leaves too. Now Olena feels safe at work again.

c065.title: Big changes at the company
c065.story: Anna's aunt Iryna works at a big delivery company. One day [[top management]] announces big changes. They write a [[business case]] for a new way of working. Every [[business process]] in the company must change. They also cut [[middle management]] to save [[resources|resource]]. Aunt Iryna has worked in [[management]] in this [[sector]] for fifteen years. She is not happy about the changes. At dinner, Anna asks about her [[motive]] for leaving the company. "I want to choose my own projects," Aunt Iryna explains. Leaving is a long [[process]], with many papers and meetings. But after two months, she starts [[freelance]] work from home, and she loves it.

c066.title: Professor Brown's class
c066.story: It is Anna's first [[class]] this [[semester]]. Her teacher is [[Professor|professor]] Brown. He has an [[old-school]] way of teaching. He gives everyone a paper [[syllabus]]. He writes on the board with a [[marker]]. "Patience is an important [[attribute]]," he says. Then he shows them the [[campus]]. They walk to the old [[institute]] building. Anna likes him a lot. She wants to be patient too.

c067.title: Anna's English test
c067.story: Anna takes an English [[course]] at the university. Today she has a big [[test]]. It takes a [[minimum]] of two hours. First, she reads a [[text]] and writes a [[dialogue]]. Then she writes an [[essay]] about Kyiv. She chooses the right [[adjective]] and a [[synonym]]. The [[context]] helps her find each Ukrainian [[equivalent]]. Later, the teacher shows her two small mistakes. She forgets a [[comma]] and a [[consonant]]. But she still gets a good grade!

c068.title: Small talk with exchange students
c068.story: Anna meets three exchange students from India, Ireland and Texas. Priya from India also speaks [[Hindi]]. At first, [[small talk]] is hard for Anna. There is a language [[barrier]], and everyone has a different [[accent]]. Liam from Ireland uses a lot of [[slang]]. Jake from Texas speaks a southern [[dialect]]. When Jake says "Great weather!" in the rain, it is [[sarcasm]]. Liam laughs and says "Time flies," a famous [[cliché]]. Priya writes "LOL" in the chat, and Anna learns a new [[acronym]]. Liam's cousin is "between jobs," a polite [[euphemism]] for no work. Anna understands that every word can carry a [[nuance]]. By the end of the evening, they are good friends.

c069.title: Taras's math homework
c069.story: Anna's little brother Taras has [[algebra]] homework from [[Mrs.]] Koval. He is sad because it looks very hard. Anna shows him an easy [[method]]. First, they take a [[calculator]] from the drawer. They use a [[formula]] with [[pi]]. With it, they find the [[radius]] of a circle. Next, they find the [[perimeter]] of a square. After that, Taras draws a [[cube]], a [[cylinder]] and an [[oval]]. "Math is fun with you!" he says. The next day, he gets a top grade.

c070.title: Anna studies online
c070.story: Anna is taking an [[online course]] in marketing. Her learning app shows a thirty-day [[streak]], and she is proud. Every evening she watches a video [[tutorial]]. Each [[module]] of the [[e-learning]] program has a short quiz. For hard topics, she books [[one-to-one]] lessons on the student [[portal]]. After six weeks, she gets a [[certificate]]! Her teacher says, "You should apply for a [[grant]]." Anna fills in the form that same night.

c071.title: A day in the library
c071.story: On Saturday, Anna spends the whole day in the old university library. First, she visits its [[archive]] in the basement. She finds a huge [[encyclopedia]] and an old [[atlas]] of the world. She also finds an old [[manuscript]] in [[Latin]]. Anna cannot read it, but she takes a picture. Later, she sits by the window with a [[paperback]]. It is [[fiction]], a mystery about a lost ship. The [[author]] writes under a [[pseudonym]]. In the [[prologue]], the writer explains how the story began. Anna reads until the library closes.

c072.title: Trouble at Taras's school
c072.story: Some older boys at school play a cruel [[prank]] on Taras. They hide his bag and laugh at him. They call him a [[geek]] and a [[loser]] for his high [[IQ]]. Then a [[hater]] writes mean comments about him online. The [[bullying]] really gets on his [[nerves|nerve]]. Soon Taras has a nervous [[tic]] in his eye. Anna talks to his teacher about the problem. The school gives Taras a [[mentor]], a kind older student named Dmytro. They talk every week, and Taras feels strong again.
